name: Porter Local-First PaaS
description: Local-first PaaS + agentic GitOps over kind/k3s (n=1 workstation tier). Deploys and runs workloads on-device; PR-driven GitOps, signed images, evidence bundles. This is the node that the HyperSwarm cluster scale-up wrapper scales UP from — Porter (local, n=1) → Scale-Up (cluster) → Cloud.

composes_with.note: Same workload; Porter provisions it locally (kind/k3s), the scale-up wrapper pins upstream cluster toolchains (kubespray/krew/Cluster-API) to expand it — pinned, not vendored.
